mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (id, post_id, user_id, parent_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments r WHERE r.parent_id = c.id) AS reply_count FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
